description: Put your own digital twin (a factory, a line, a building, a lesson) on the shared 3D globe at maps.ce-net.com. Send a manifest and one JavaScript module exporting `start(ctx)` (the globe sandbox: ctx.local, ctx.box, ctx.model, ctx.points, ctx.arc, ctx.ring, ctx.fly, ctx.orbit, ctx.panel, ctx.steps, ctx.every, ctx.on, ctx.set, ctx.log; no network, no storage, no eval). Every submission is checked by machine rules, reviewed by an AI for purpose, honesty, craft, safety and slop (pass at 70 of 100), and opened headless on the live globe (no errors, not blank). Pass: it is published and opens at maps.ce-net.com/?app=<id>. Refused: the answer lists the reasons and the exact fixes; apply them and submit again. Use dry=true to get the review without publishing. Needs a signed-in connection; the id stays yours.

dry.description: review and render only, publish nothing

entry_js.description: the module source, 200 bytes to 256 KB, `export async function start(ctx) { ... }`, readable (not minified)

entry_url.description: instead of entry_js: an https URL of the module

manifest.description: {id (3-40 of a-z0-9-), title (3-60), what (20-240: what it shows and where the data comes from), kind (scene|twin|layer|lesson), needs (the ctx ops it uses: local, box, model, points, arc, ring, fly, orbit, base, steps, panel), data (https URLs), models (https .glb URLs)}

name: twin_submit
title: Globe: submit a digital twin
